name: Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah, Dubai
positioning: Beachfront urban resort on the Arabian Gulf with views of Dubai's skyline
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront stay with Dubai skyline views
Food-focused guests drawn to a Michelin-starred Portuguese restaurant
Guests who value a spa with a sea front VIP suite

facts.text: Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, Dubai is described as a stylish urban resort overlooking the clear blue waters of the Arabian Gulf.
The hotel's skyline views are of Dubai's glittering skyline, dominated by Burj Khalifa.
The hotel has a beachfront location and al fresco facilities.
Tasca by José Avillez is a one-Michelin starred restaurant serving Portuguese flavours.
Tasca is located on the sixth floor of the hotel.
Tasca offers both indoor and outdoor dining on a terrace with infinity pool overlooking the Gulf.
The Bay is a beachside brasserie serving Mediterranean-inspired cuisine.
Noor Lounge, in the lobby, offers Afternoon Tea.
The hotel's spa is spread over 2,000 sqm.
The hotel has a Hammam-style suite in its spa.
The spa facilities include a Steam Room, Sauna and Vitality Pool.

highlights.text: Deluxe Sea View Rooms have captivating views of the Arabian Gulf, a private balcony and a marble bath.
Club rooms include use of the Club Lounge and complimentary daily breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
Premier Sea View Rooms have a large private balcony with views of the Arabian Gulf.
The spa has a luxurious sea front VIP suite.
The hotel offers beach classes among its fitness options.

considerations.text: Beachwear, sportswear and flip-flops are not permitted during dinner service.
Advance reservations are recommended, particularly for Tasca by José Avillez and Netsu by Ross Shonhan.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting an ultra-high-end positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
